caseName: City of Texarkana v. Arkansas Louisiana Gas Co.
caseNameFull: City of Texarkana, Texas v. Arkansas Louisiana Gas Co.
attorneys: Messrs. Ed B. Levee and Benjamin E. Carter for petitioner. Messrs. Henry C. Walker, Jr., William C. Fitzhugh, and William H. Arnold, Jr. for respondent.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

On consideration of the stipulation of the parties the judgment of the Circuit Court of Appeals is vacated and the cause is remanded to the District Court with directions to enter appropriate orders. The costs in this Court are to be paid by the respondent.
